definitions.explanation: Substances consumed for nutrition; things that are eaten.

examples.japanese: {食物|しょくもつ}アレルギーがある。
{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}は{健康|けんこう}に{良|よ}い。
examples.english: Dietary fiber is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}について{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned about the food chain.

notes:
A more formal/technical term for food compared to {食|た}べ{物|もの}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{食物|しょくもつ}アレルギー (food allergy)
・{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} (dietary fiber)
・{食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ} (food chain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{食|た}べ{物|もの} (food - everyday term)
・{食物|しょくもつ} (food - technical/formal)
・{食品|しょくひん} (food products - commercial)
・{食料|しょくりょう} (provisions, food supplies)
・{食糧|しょくりょう} (provisions, rations - often for emergencies)

NUANCE:
{食物|しょくもつ} is used in scientific, medical, and formal contexts rather than everyday conversation.
